title: Orders ingestion skipped late-arriving records
root_cause: The incremental watermark advanced before late-arriving source records were committed, while the MERGE key did not enforce source uniqueness.
impact: Orders were missing from downstream reporting and a subset of records was duplicated.
resolution: Reverted the watermark change, replayed the affected time window and deduplicated the source batch before MERGE.
prevention: Test late-arriving records at watermark boundaries

title: Duplicate order rows after merge-key update
root_cause: A nullable business key caused multiple source rows to match the same target record during an incremental MERGE.
impact: Order counts were overstated in the analytics layer for two reporting cycles.
resolution: Added null-key quarantine, deterministic deduplication and a one-time target cleanup.
prevention: Reject or quarantine null merge keys
Check source uniqueness at the target grain

title: Customer profile API schema mismatch
root_cause: A response field changed from nullable to required without a compatibility window.
impact: Two downstream consumers rejected otherwise valid profile events.
resolution: Restored nullable behaviour and introduced a versioned API contract.
prevention: Use additive schema changes where possible

title: Payment authorization errors after credential rotation
root_cause: One worker pool retained an expired credential after the secret rotation event.
impact: Authorization requests failed intermittently and checkout latency increased.
resolution: Restarted stale workers and added credential refresh validation.
prevention: Verify token refresh across every worker pool
Test rotation without full service restart

title: Pipeline lag increased after orchestration schedule change
root_cause: The revised schedule launched overlapping jobs that contended for the same warehouse resources.
impact: Inventory freshness degraded from minutes to several hours.
resolution: Reduced concurrency and staggered dependent jobs.
prevention: Review dependency graph before schedule changes

title: High CPU after container base image upgrade
root_cause: A transitive library changed its thread-pool defaults after the base image upgrade.
impact: Autoscaling increased compute spend and p95 latency rose during peak traffic.
resolution: Pinned the library version and constrained worker concurrency.
prevention: Run load tests on the new image
Track CPU and p95 latency during canary

title: Customer events rejected after field rename
root_cause: A producer renamed a field before all consumers had migrated to the new schema.
impact: A portion of customer activity events was sent to the dead-letter queue.
resolution: Restored the old field temporarily and deployed a dual-field compatibility period.
prevention: Keep a dual-read transition for breaking changes

title: Warehouse merge caused lock contention
root_cause: A broader MERGE predicate scanned and locked a much larger target range than expected.
impact: Several downstream finance jobs missed their processing window.
resolution: Restored partition pruning and split the MERGE into bounded batches.
prevention: Review query plans for MERGE changes
Monitor lock waits and job duration

title: Export API throttling caused delayed synchronization
root_cause: The retry policy used a fixed interval and did not honor Retry-After headers.
impact: Synchronization lag increased and API quota consumption spiked.
resolution: Implemented exponential backoff with jitter and Retry-After handling.
prevention: Track connector lag and quota usage

title: Cache configuration caused stale product prices
root_cause: The cache TTL was increased without invalidating entries after price updates.
impact: Some customers saw outdated prices until the cache expired.
resolution: Restored the previous TTL and forced invalidation for affected keys.
prevention: Review TTL changes with freshness requirements

title: Batch job memory exhaustion after partition change
root_cause: A partition-count reduction created oversized shuffle partitions and executor memory pressure.
impact: The nightly customer aggregation failed repeatedly and delayed reporting.
resolution: Restored partition sizing and enabled adaptive query execution for the affected workload.

title: Webhook events processed twice after retry change
root_cause: The retry handler generated a new event identifier for each delivery attempt.
impact: A subset of customer notifications was delivered more than once.
resolution: Used the provider event ID as an idempotency key and replayed only failed events.
prevention: Keep idempotency keys stable across retries

title: Database connection exhaustion after pool-size update
root_cause: The per-instance pool size was increased without accounting for autoscaling instance count.
impact: Database connections were exhausted and account requests timed out.
resolution: Reduced pool size and introduced a database connection budget.
prevention: Calculate maximum connections at peak scale

title: ETL backfill overloaded source database
root_cause: The backfill ran without throttling and read the full historical range in parallel.
impact: Source database latency increased and operational workloads were degraded.
resolution: Paused the backfill and restarted it in date-bounded, throttled batches.

title: Search index unavailable after infrastructure rollout
root_cause: The rollout replaced too many nodes at once and temporarily removed quorum.
impact: Search requests returned errors during the deployment window.
resolution: Rolled back the node rollout and reintroduced nodes sequentially.
